Digital Assistant · AI says:

Our two best value-for-money options are the Gold and Platinum Barkers & Co tiers.

Gold Tier

Spend threshold: $500–$1499 annually.
Earn rate: 2 Barkers Dollars per $20 on full-price; 1 per $20 on sale/outlet.
Extras: $30 birthday reward + $30 annual tier bonus.

Platinum Tier

Spend threshold: $1500+ annually.
Earn rate: same as Gold: 2 Barkers Dollars per $20 full-price; 1 per $20 sale/outlet.
Extras: $100 birthday reward, $50 annual tier bonus, free NZ shipping, plus all Gold perks.

Comparison for value

If you spend around $500–$1500 per year, Gold delivers strong value with double earn rates on full-price items and both birthday and annual Barkers Dollars rewards.
If you regularly spend $1500+ per year, Platinum offers the best value: you get every Gold benefit plus much higher birthday and annual rewards and free NZ shipping, which can significantly increase overall savings over a year.

In short, Gold is the best value for moderate annual spenders, while Platinum becomes the best value-for-money choice if your yearly spend comfortably exceeds the Platinum threshold and you’ll benefit from the extra rewards and free shipping.

Barkers & Co Loyalty Tiers
